brief: A workbench organizer: two storeys, bins on top, a drawer below, all edges capped.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Build has level 0 and level 1: piece:0,0,0;full with snap + piece:0,0,1;full on top (connected via snap:0,0,0), and matching half-bases piece:1,0,0;half-n and piece:1,0,1;half-n. Measure y=169mm confirms ~2 storeys.
Top storey (level 1) holds two bins: bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full (full hex bin on full base) and bin:1,0,1~hex-bin-half-n-full (half bin on half base), both placed via addBin sockets s128/s110.
Drawer: drawer:0#1,0#cut (key s) installed on half base piece:1,0,0;half-n at level 0 via addDrawer s125, opened for visibility.

capOpenFaces + lockJoints applied: 12 caps installed (cap:0,0,0;* x5, cap:0,0,1;* x3, cap:1,0,0;* x2, cap:1,0,1;* x2) and jointBolt:1#0,0#0. check_build ok=true, meshClash=clear, no OPEN_CAP_FACE issues.

finish.summary: Workbench organizer built as two-storey (levels 0-1): full + half bases on each level, two bins on the top storey and a drawer on the lower half-base. All open faces capped (12 solid caps) and joints locked; check_build passes meshClash clear. Dressed with workshop props in bins for staging.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your two-storey organiser is on deck — I'll get the bins up top, drawer below, edges capped.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base (variant half-n, half-s, half-e or half-w) first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
